name: Graphs on 42 vertices without five- or six-cycles
description: construct() -> list of edges [u, v] of a simple graph on vertices 0..41 containing neither a five-cycle nor a six-cycle. Maximize the number of edges; the known optimum is 104. The exact value 104 for n = 42 is known; the task recovers it.
